confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors come from secondary budget and cost-of-living pages. Some are crowd-sourced or modeled, several are dated (2023 to 2025), and they conflict: cappuccino figures range from about $1.60 to $5.10, and the implied peso rates differ widely. The wine glass figure rests on one 2025 Mendoza data point plus upscale reviews, and the cocktail figure uses a beer-relative estimate and a modeled nightlife figure. Meal figures for two use European-currency budget pages converted approximately. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Argentine inflation and peso volatility mean USD levels may shift quickly from the July 2026 window.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink levels are anchored to Mendoza-specific secondary budget and cost-of-living pages, with the wine glass reflecting Mendoza's wine-region restaurant context and the cocktail set relative to beer. Accommodation is a holistic model judgment relative to other mid-sized Argentine tourist cities and regional Latin American tourism hubs.
